items.title: PostgreSQL Like A Pro: Build, query, and troubleshoot without leaving VS Code

sentences.en: PostgreSQL Like A Pro: Build, query, and troubleshoot without leaving VS Code.
sentences.zh: PostgreSQL Like A Pro ：无需离开VS Code即可进行构建、查询和故障排除。

sentences.en: You’re building an app in VS Code.
sentences.zh: 您正在VS Code中构建应用。

sentences.en: Then you need to check a table, understand how two tables connect, or figure out why a query is slow.
sentences.zh: 然后，您需要检查一个表，了解两个表是如何连接的，或者找出查询速度慢的原因。

sentences.en: That often means opening another tool and finding your way back to the code.
sentences.zh: 这通常意味着打开另一个工具并找到返回代码的路。

sentences.en: The PostgreSQL extension for VS Code brings common database tasks into your editor.
sentences.zh: PostgreSQL VS Code扩展将常见数据库任务带入编辑器。

sentences.en: You can explore database objects, write and run SQL, and use database context with GitHub Copilot as you work.
sentences.zh: 您可以探索数据库对象，编写和运行SQL ，并在工作时使用GitHub Copilot的数据库上下文。

sentences.en: Here are four ways to make that part of your development workflow, from finding your first table to reviewing a performance recommendation.
sentences.zh: 从查找第一张表格到查看绩效建议，以下是使该内容成为开发工作流程的一部分的四种方法。

sentences.en: Each section includes a video from PostgreSQL Like a Pro: VS Code Edition if you’d like to follow along.
sentences.zh: 每个部分都包含来自PostgreSQL Like a Pro: VS Code Edition的视频（如果您想跟进的话）。

sentences.en: Get connected and find your way around Before writing a query, you need to know what’s in the database.
sentences.zh: 在撰写查询之前，您需要了解数据库中的内容。

sentences.en: Install Microsoft’s PostgreSQL extension, then select the PostgreSQL icon in the Activity Bar to add a connection.
sentences.zh: 安装Microsoft的PostgreSQL扩展，然后在活动栏中选择PostgreSQL图标以添加连接。

sentences.en: You can connect to on-premises or cloud databases and save connection profiles to reuse later.
sentences.zh: 您可以连接到本地或云数据库，并保存连接配置文件以便稍后重用。

items.title: AWS Weekly Roundup: Amazon Polly Generative engine, TorchNeuron for Trainium, and more (October 26, 2026)

sentences.en: AWS Weekly Roundup: Amazon Polly Generative engine, TorchNeuron for Trainium, and more (October 26, 2026).
sentences.zh: AWS每周综述： Amazon Polly生成引擎、Trainium的TorchNeuron等（ 2026年10月26日）。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago I presented to a small group of commercial and technology leaders from Brazilian agribusiness at the AWS office in São Paulo.
sentences.zh: 几周前，我在圣保罗的AWS办公室向巴西农业综合企业的一小群商业和技术领导者进行了演讲。

sentences.en: My talk ran through where generative AI fits across the different stages of an agribusiness operation, and the point I kept returning to is that the markets we call traditional are exactly the ones where keeping up with this technology decides who ends up ahead of the curve.
sentences.zh: 我的演讲贯穿了生成式人工智能适用于农业综合企业运营的不同阶段，我不断回到的一点是，我们称之为传统的市场正是跟上这项技术的市场，决定谁最终走在曲线的前面。

sentences.en: Nobody there was arguing about whether AI belongs in agriculture.
sentences.zh: 那里没有人争论人工智能是否属于农业。

sentences.en: The questions were about delivery: who receives the output, in which language, on which device, often while driving between farms.
sentences.zh: 问题是关于交付的：谁接收输出，使用哪种语言，在哪种设备上，通常是在农场之间行驶时。

sentences.en: That is why a launch I might otherwise have filed under routine leads my list this week.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我本来可能在例行公事下提交的发布会在本周排在我的名单前面。

sentences.en: The Amazon Polly Generative engine upgrade added 14 new voices, two of them in Brazilian Portuguese.
sentences.zh: Amazon Polly Generative引擎升级增加了14种新声音，其中两种是巴西葡萄牙语。

sentences.en: When your user has both hands on a steering wheel, the interface is a voice.
sentences.zh: 当您的用户双手放在方向盘上时，界面就是一个声音。

sentences.en: Presenting “GenAI no Agronegócio Brasileiro” at the AWS office in São Paulo.
sentences.zh: 在圣保罗的AWS办事处展示“GenAI no Agronegócio Brasileiro”。

sentences.en: The rest of the week had a sharper edge.
sentences.zh: 本周剩余时间的边缘更加锋利。

sentences.en: The biggest launch is a security service built on the premise that the gap between a vulnerability being disclosed and a vulnerability being exploited has effectively closed, and AWS published the honeypot evidence for exactly that in the same week.
sentences.zh: 最大的发布是建立在被披露的漏洞和被利用的漏洞之间的差距已经有效弥合的前提下的安全服务， AWS在同一周发布了蜜罐证据。

sentences.en: Now, let’s get into this week’s AWS news… AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available AWS Continuum reframes vulnerability management as an end-to-end job rather than a scanner that hands you a list.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来看看本周的AWS新闻……针对代码漏洞的AWS Continuum现已正式推出AWS Continuum将漏洞管理重新构建为端到端工作，而不是向您提供列表的扫描仪。

sentences.en: Devin Jacob Ballard, 20, denies charges that he fatally strangled Anna Yagi, 39, in a hotel on the island of Okinawa Prosecutors in Japan have filed formal charges against a US marine suspected of murdering and robbing a woman while stationed on the country’s island of Okinawa, according to Japanese media.

items.title: Sudan paramilitary drone strikes cause mass power cuts in eastern states

sentences.en: Sudan paramilitary drone strikes cause mass power cuts in eastern states.
sentences.zh: 苏丹准军事无人机袭击导致东部各州大规模停电。

sentences.en: Rapid Support Forces strike five power stations in three states controlled by Sudanese army Sudan’s paramilitary Rapid Support Forces have launched a coordinated drone attack against five power stations, causing mass power outages across the country’s east, a government official said.
sentences.zh: 一名政府官员表示，快速支援部队袭击了苏丹军队控制的三个州的五个发电站，苏丹准军事组织快速支援部队对五个发电站发动了协调一致的无人机袭击，导致该国东部地区大规模停电。

sentences.en: The drones hit two power stations each in the states of Al-Jazira and Gedaref and one in White Nile state, “resulting in power outages across large parts of these three states”, the official said on condition of anonymity.
sentences.zh: 这位不愿透露姓名的官员说，无人机袭击了Al-Jazira和Gedaref州的两个发电站，以及白尼罗州的一个发电站， “导致这三个州的大部分地区停电”。

items.title: ‘Zero-energy companionship’: bizarre hobby takes seed among China’s stressed young adults

sentences.en: ‘Zero-energy companionship’: bizarre hobby takes seed among China’s stressed young adults.
sentences.zh: “零能耗伴侣” ：奇怪的爱好在中国压力很大的年轻人中播下种子。

sentences.en: Faced with a stagnant jobs market, many are spurning children or pets in favour of ‘raising bricks’ Young adults in China looking for a cheaper, low-maintenance alternative to having children or pets have found an answer: raising bricks.
sentences.zh: 面对停滞不前的就业市场，许多人正在抛弃儿童或宠物，转而“养砖”中国的年轻人正在寻找一种比养孩子或宠物更便宜、维护成本更低的替代品，他们找到了一个答案：养砖。

sentences.en: Bricks may not be as cuddly as cats or as life-affirming as human offspring, but they also cost next to nothing.
sentences.zh: 砖块可能不像猫那么可爱，也不像人类后代那样有生命力，但它们的成本几乎为零。

sentences.en: “No cats, no dating, I started raising a brick,” wrote one brick parent on social media.
sentences.zh: 一位砖头父母在社交媒体上写道： “没有猫，没有约会，我开始养砖头。”

items.title: Trump escalates anti-Muslim attacks against El-Sayed in Michigan

sentences.en: Trump escalates anti-Muslim attacks against El-Sayed in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 特朗普升级了对密歇根州El-Sayed的反穆斯林攻击。

sentences.en: President Trump intensified his anti-Muslim rhetoric against Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed on Sunday, portraying him as a threat to national security and questioning his loyalty to the United States.
sentences.zh: 周日，特朗普总统加强了对密歇根州参议院候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德的反穆斯林言论，将他描述为对国家安全的威胁，并质疑他对美国的忠诚。

items.title: Loggers say Roadless Rule repeal won't solve their biggest challenges

sentences.en: Loggers say Roadless Rule repeal won't solve their biggest challenges.
sentences.zh: 记录者表示，无路规则的废除不会解决他们面临的最大挑战。

sentences.en: President Trump is planning to open up some of the nation's last pristine forests to road building and timber companies.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统正计划向道路建设和木材公司开放该国最后一片原始森林。

sentences.en: But those who work in the woods say it won't do enough to revive the industry.
sentences.zh: 但那些在森林里工作的人说，这对振兴这个行业来说还不够。

items.title: UK poised to miss reduced aid spending target of 0.3% of national income

sentences.en: UK poised to miss reduced aid spending target of 0.3% of national income.
sentences.zh: 英国有望错过削减援助支出占国民收入0.3%的目标。

sentences.en: Calculations from the Center for Global Development say spending next year is likely to be £410m less than anticipated The UK is on course to miss its target of spending 0.3% of national income on international aid by an estimated £400m by the end of next year.
sentences.zh: 全球发展中心(Center for Global Development)的计算显示，明年的支出可能比预期少4.1亿英镑。英国有望在明年年底前实现将国民收入的0.3%用于国际援助的目标，预计将减少4亿英镑。

sentences.en: Calculations from the Center for Global Development (CGD) found the UK was on course for a large shortfall in promised official development assistance at the end of 2027.
sentences.zh: 全球发展中心（ CGD ）的计算发现，到2027年底，英国承诺的官方发展援助将出现巨大缺口。

items.title: Australian murderer loses bid to eat Vegemite in prison

sentences.en: Australian murderer loses bid to eat Vegemite in prison.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚凶手在监狱中失去了吃Vegemite的竞标。

sentences.en: Andre McKechnie, who murdered a property developer, argued it was his right to enjoy Australian culture.
sentences.zh: 谋杀了一名房地产开发商的Andre McKechnie认为，享受澳大利亚文化是他的权利。

items.title: Watch: How President Lula turned it around to beat Flávio Bolsonaro

sentences.en: Watch: How President Lula turned it around to beat Flávio Bolsonaro.
sentences.zh: 观看：卢拉总统如何扭转局面，击败弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗。

sentences.en: Brazil's left-wing President has been elected for a fourth term after narrowly beating right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro in a knife-edge vote.
sentences.zh: 巴西左翼总统弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）在刀锋投票中以微弱优势击败右翼后，第四次当选。

items.title: Xi Jinping’s corruption crackdown in the spotlight as China prepares for meeting of top leaders

sentences.en: Xi Jinping’s corruption crackdown in the spotlight as China prepares for meeting of top leaders.
sentences.zh: 在中国准备与最高领导人会晤之际，习近平的反腐败行动备受瞩目。

sentences.en: The fifth plenum comes against a backdrop of years of purges that have had some analysts wondering if the issue is corruption or a lack of loyalty When Xi Jinping came to power in 2012, he pledged to stamp out corruption all through the ranks of the Communist party.
sentences.zh: 五中全会的背景是多年的清洗，一些分析人士怀疑这个问题是腐败还是缺乏忠诚。2012年习近平上台时，他承诺要彻底消除共产党内部的腐败现象。

sentences.en: More than a decade later, the pace of investigations has not slowed.
sentences.zh: 十多年后，调查的步伐并没有放缓。

sentences.en: Last year, China’s disciplinary authorities opened investigations into more than 1 million people, including more than 100 officials at or above ministerial or provincial level.
sentences.zh: 去年，中国纪律部门对100多万人展开调查，其中包括100多名部级或省级以上官员。

sentences.en: As Chinese Communist party (CCP) officials kick off an important meeting this week, discipline – and party loyalty – is high on the agenda.
sentences.zh: 随着中国共产党（ CCP ）官员本周开始举行重要会议，纪律和党的忠诚度是议程上的重要议题。

sentences.en: For those who try to read the tea leaves of elite Chinese politics, concern about the apparent lack of discipline is dominating CCP discussions.
sentences.zh: 对于那些试图阅读中国精英政治茶叶的人来说，对明显缺乏纪律的担忧正在主导中共的讨论。
